newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear to invest $11.3 mln in Chile plant.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear to invest $11.3 mln in Chile plant.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said Wednesday it will invest $11.3 million in the company's plant in Santiago, Chile.
Goodyear chairman Samir Gibara, who made the announcement in Chile, said the investment will enable the plant to increase its total tire capacity by 14 percent.
Gibara said about 50 percent of the Chile plant's products were exported, and with the new investment, the company anticipate exports will increase to about one million tires, or to 60 percent.

The bulk of the investment will be used for equipment to expand production capabilities of bias ply racing tires. The racing tires are used primarily in drag racing, short-track asphalt racing and dirt track and sport car racing series in the United States.

Goodyear said in January that bias race tire manufacturing would be phased out in Akron because of "continuing financial losses." Radial racing tires will continue to be made at the Goodyear Technical Center in Akron.
